name: Buildium
description: Buildium is property-management software for rental and association portfolios, combining leasing, resident and owner records, maintenance, accounting, payments, communications, reporting and marketplace integrations.
agentUseSummary: Connect a dedicated customer-owned Buildium production client ID and secret through Railway's encrypted boundary, then let selected agents list or inspect bounded privacy-redacted rental-property and unit summaries through four read-only tools.

credentialRequirements.name: BUILDIUM_CLIENT_ID
credentialRequirements.label: Buildium client ID
credentialRequirements.helpText: Create a dedicated production API key in an eligible Buildium Premium account and store its client ID encrypted.

credentialRequirements.name: BUILDIUM_CLIENT_SECRET
credentialRequirements.label: Buildium client secret
credentialRequirements.helpText: Store the matching secret encrypted; Relay sends it only to api.buildium.com.

capabilities.label: Read rental-property inventory
capabilities.description: List or inspect bounded rental-property and unit summaries without people, street addresses, market rent, bank identifiers, notes or financial data.

allowed.label: List rental properties
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five privacy-redacted rental-property summaries from the first Buildium page.

allowed.label: Read a rental property
allowed.description: Read one exact privacy-redacted Buildium rental-property summary.

allowed.label: List rental units
allowed.description: List at most twenty-five privacy-redacted rental-unit summaries from the first Buildium page.

allowed.label: Read a rental unit
allowed.description: Read one exact privacy-redacted Buildium rental-unit summary.

blocked.label: Block people and financial data
blocked.description: Tenants, applicants, owners, vendors, staff, bank accounts, ledgers, transactions, payments, bills, tax identifiers, screening and other personal or financial data are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block files, notes and communications
blocked.description: Files, images, notes, messages, announcements, phone logs, contact details and outbound communication are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block property-management changes
blocked.description: Property, unit, lease, task, work-order, accounting, payment, association, webhook and every other mutation are not exposed.

blocked.label: Block bulk and raw API access
blocked.description: Automatic pagination, arbitrary filters, sandbox switching, webhooks, raw endpoints and raw responses are not exposed.

approvalProfiles.label: Safe
approvalProfiles.description: Four bounded property-inventory reads run directly; people, finance, files, notes, communications, mutations, bulk traversal and raw API access remain blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Dangerously skip permissions
approvalProfiles.description: The same selected read surface runs without Relay per-action approval; account permissions, fixed origin, bounds, redaction and audits still apply.

runtimeSupport.description: Railway mounts four typed Buildium property-inventory reads and sends encrypted credentials only to the fixed production API origin.

providerSetup.blocker: Buildium Open API access requires an eligible Premium subscription and customer-generated production credentials. No representative customer credentials were available in this code-only shard, so live connection acceptance remains external.
providerSetup.nextAction: A Buildium administrator on an eligible Premium subscription creates a dedicated production API key restricted to Rentals > Rental properties and units View permission, enters its client ID and secret in Relay, then validates health, all four bounded reads, redaction, 10-request concurrency handling, credential replacement and disconnect denial.

evidence.supports: Buildium publishes an OpenAPI-described REST API at https://api.buildium.com/v1, requires a Premium subscription, authenticates server-to-server requests with x-buildium-client-id and x-buildium-client-secret, and limits clients to 10 concurrent requests per second.

Official rental-property and rental-unit list and exact-resource endpoints require Rentals > Rental properties and units View permission and support bounded offset/limit paging; the API separately exposes broad personal, financial, file, communication, webhook and mutation surfaces excluded by Relay.

Buildium's official privacy material covers property-management customer, resident, applicant, owner, vendor, financial, screening, device and service data, supporting critical risk and privacy-redacted results.
